        delete[] data_;

    NativeMemoryBuffer& operator=(const NativeMemoryBuffer&) = delete;

        if (this != &other) {

            data_ = std::exchange(other.data_, nullptr);

    const uint8_t* data() const noexcept { return data_; }
    size_t size() const noexcept { return size_; }

using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;

public class ConcurrentLruCache<TKey, TValue> where TKey : notnull
{
    private readonly int _capacity;
    private readonly object _syncRoot = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<TKey, LinkedListNode<CacheItem>> _map;
    private readonly LinkedList<CacheItem> _lruList = new();

    private record struct CacheItem(TKey Key, TValue Value);

    public ConcurrentLruCache(int capacity)
    {
        if (capacity <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity));
        _capacity = capacity;
        _map = new Dictionary<TKey, LinkedListNode<CacheItem>>(capacity);
    }

    public void Set(TKey key, TValue value)
    {
        lock (_syncRoot)
        {
            if (_map.TryGetValue(key, out var existingNode))
            {
                _lruList.Remove(existingNode);
                var updatedNode = new LinkedListNode<CacheItem>(new CacheItem(key, value));
                _lruList.AddFirst(updatedNode);
                _map[key] = updatedNode;
                return;
            }

            if (_map.Count >= _capacity)
            {
                var lru = _lruList.Last;
                if (lru != null)
                {
                    _lruList.RemoveLast();
                    _map.Remove(lru.Value.Key);
                }
            }

            var newNode = new LinkedListNode<CacheItem>(new CacheItem(key, value));
            _lruList.AddFirst(newNode);
            _map[key] = newNode;
        }
    }

    public bool TryGet(TKey key, out TValue value)
    {
        lock (_syncRoot)
        {
            if (_map.TryGetValue(key, out var node))
            {
                _lruList.Remove(node);
                _lruList.AddFirst(node);
                value = node.Value.Value;
                return true;
            }
            value = default!;
            return false;
        }
    }

    public int Count
    {
        get { lock (_syncRoot) return _map.Count; }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        var cache = new ConcurrentLruCache<int, string>(3);
        cache.Set(1, "one");
        cache.Set(2, "two");
        cache.Set(3, "three");
        Debug.Assert(cache.Count == 3);

        bool found = cache.TryGet(1, out var val);
        Debug.Assert(found && val == "one");

        // Key 2 was least recently used, so adding 4 evicts 2
        cache.Set(4, "four");
        Debug.Assert(cache.Count == 3);
        Debug.Assert(!cache.TryGet(2, out _));
        Debug.Assert(cache.TryGet(1, out val) && val == "one");
        Debug.Assert(cache.TryGet(3, out val) && val == "three");
        Debug.Assert(cache.TryGet(4, out val) && val == "four");

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"hash/fnv"
	"sync"
)

const NumShards = 32

type Shard struct {
	sync.RWMutex
	items map[string]int
}

type ShardedMap struct {
	shards [NumShards]*Shard
}

func NewShardedMap() *ShardedMap {
	sm := &ShardedMap{}
	for i := 0; i < NumShards; i++ {
		sm.shards[i] = &Shard{
			items: make(map[string]int),
		}
	}
	return sm
}

func (sm *ShardedMap) getShard(key string) *Shard {
	h := fnv.New32a()
	h.Write([]byte(key))
	idx := h.Sum32() % NumShards
	return sm.shards[idx]
}

func (sm *ShardedMap) Set(key string, val int) {
	shard := sm.getShard(key)
	shard.Lock()
	defer shard.Unlock()
	shard.items[key] = val
}

func (sm *ShardedMap) Get(key string) (int, bool) {
	shard := sm.getShard(key)
	shard.RLock()
	defer shard.RUnlock()
	val, ok := shard.items[key]
	return val, ok
}

func main() {
	sm := NewShardedMap()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup

	for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(idx int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			k := fmt.Sprintf("key-%d", idx)
			sm.Set(k, idx*10)
		}(i)
	}

	wg.Wait()

	for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
		k := fmt.Sprintf("key-%d", i)
		val, ok := sm.Get(k)
		if !ok || val != i*10 {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("Mismatch for %s: got %d, expected %d", k, val, i*10))
		}
	}

	fmt.Println("GO SFT 0002: ShardedMap 32-shard concurrent verification passed.")

import java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class BoundedBlockingQueue<T> {
    private final Object[] items;
    private int head;
    private int tail;
    private int count;

    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Condition notEmpty = lock.newCondition();
    private final Condition notFull = lock.newCondition();

    public BoundedBlockingQueue(int capacity) {
        if (capacity <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Capacity must be positive");
        this.items = new Object[capacity];
    }

    public void put(T item) throws InterruptedException {
        if (item == null) throw new NullPointerException("Null items not supported");
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (count == items.length) {
                notFull.await();
            }
            items[tail] = item;
            if (++tail == items.length) tail = 0;
            count++;
            notEmpty.signal();
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public T take() throws InterruptedException {
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (count == 0) {
                notEmpty.await();
            }
            T item = (T) items[head];
            items[head] = null; // Prevent memory leak
            if (++head == items.length) head = 0;
            count--;
            notFull.signal();
            return item;
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.lock();
        try {
            return count;
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BoundedBlockingQueue<Integer> queue = new BoundedBlockingQueue<>(4);
        AtomicInteger totalSum = new AtomicInteger(0);

        Thread consumer = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                    totalSum.addAndGet(queue.take());
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
        });

        Thread producer = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
                    queue.put(i);
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
        });

        consumer.start();
        producer.start();
        producer.join();
        consumer.join();

        // 1..50 = (50 * 51) / 2 = 1275
        assert totalSum.get() == 1275 : "Expected 1275, got " + totalSum.get();
        assert queue.size() == 0 : "Queue should be empty";

        System.out.println("JAVA SFT 0002: BoundedBlockingQueue verified. Sum: " + totalSum.get());
    }

use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::sync::RwLock;

pub struct ShardedLruCache<K, V> {
    shards: Vec<RwLock<LruShard<K, V>>>,
    num_shards: usize,
}

struct LruShard<K, V> {
    capacity: usize,
    map: HashMap<K, V>,
    order: VecDeque<K>,
}

impl<K: Hash + Eq + Clone, V: Clone> ShardedLruCache<K, V> {
    pub fn new(capacity_per_shard: usize, num_shards: usize) -> Self {
        let mut shards = Vec::with_capacity(num_shards);
        for _ in 0..num_shards {
            shards.push(RwLock::new(LruShard {
                capacity: capacity_per_shard,
                map: HashMap::new(),
                order: VecDeque::new(),
            }));
        }
        Self { shards, num_shards }
    }

    fn shard_idx(&self, key: &K) -> usize {
        let mut hasher = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
        key.hash(&mut hasher);
        (hasher.finish() as usize) % self.num_shards
    }

    pub fn insert(&self, key: K, value: V) {
        let idx = self.shard_idx(&key);
        let mut shard = self.shards[idx].write().unwrap();

        if shard.map.contains_key(&key) {
            shard.order.retain(|k| k != &key);
        } else if shard.map.len() >= shard.capacity {
            if let Some(oldest) = shard.order.pop_front() {
                shard.map.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        shard.order.push_back(key.clone());
        shard.map.insert(key, value);
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &K) -> Option<V> {
        let idx = self.shard_idx(key);
        let mut shard = self.shards[idx].write().unwrap();
        if let Some(val) = shard.map.get(key).cloned() {
            shard.order.retain(|k| k != key);
            shard.order.push_back(key.clone());
            Some(val)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let cache = ShardedLruCache::<String, i32>::new(2, 4);
    cache.insert("alpha".to_string(), 1);
    cache.insert("beta".to_string(), 2);

    assert_eq!(cache.get(&"alpha".to_string()), Some(1));
    assert_eq!(cache.get(&"beta".to_string()), Some(2));
    assert_eq!(cache.get(&"gamma".to_string()), None);

    println!("RUST SFT 0002: ShardedLruCache verified.");
}<|im_end|>
